source_method: Live network/provider availability-checker controls; official provider primary pages only; web-verified 2026-07-24; metadata-only
fixed_operations_global: No verified external-runner output; no duplicate retry
Network-record-backed current/future Full Fibre states retained
CityFibre, Gigaclear, Quickline, Fibrus, Wessex, Grain and toob retained
Checker states classified as available/planned/building/no-plan where supported
No property availability asserted until checker is queried for a concrete address
Runtime/global scores unchanged without runner evidence

sources.name: Openreach Fibre availability checker
sources.coverage: UK address-level Openreach broadband product availability and Full Fibre rollout state
sources.update_cadence: Linked directly to Openreach network records and updated regularly
sources.role: High-value live orderability/build-state cross-check for Openreach-served premises
sources.limitations: Plans can change; a checker result should be captured for the exact address and does not represent other networks

sources.name: CityFibre availability checker

sources.limitations: Commercial checker coverage is limited to Gigaclear network and must be queried for the property
